zh.app.name: 白话智能体
zh.app.title.board: 审稿台 · 白话智能体
zh.lang.label: 语言
zh.front.hero.title: 把一篇论文，写成公众读得懂的稿子。
zh.front.hero.lead: 读论文，抽出一份「依据清单」，为不同平台起草，再用另一个模型逐句核对。任何超出依据的说法都会标出来交给你处理。
zh.front.hero.note: 稿子永远不会自动发布。
zh.front.demo.caption: 依据清单里有什么，稿子里才能写什么
zh.front.demo.claim: 在12只小鼠中，肿瘤体积平均缩小了23%
zh.front.demo.meta: high · 小鼠, n=12, 初步
zh.front.demo.writtenText: 在12只小鼠中（初步结果），肿瘤体积平均缩小了23%
zh.front.demo.why: 丢掉了物种、样本量与「初步」——依据清单撑不起这句话。
zh.front.rules.head: 不会妥协的四条
zh.front.rules.1.title: 写得出，就查得到
zh.front.rules.1.body: 数字、因果、程度、「首次」、「证明」——任何一句这样的话都必须对应依据清单里的一条，否则不写。
zh.front.rules.2.title: 限定词跟着走
zh.front.rules.2.body: 物种、样本量、「初步」、相关不等于因果——起草时保留，核对时检查。
zh.front.rules.3.title: 不自己给自己打分
zh.front.rules.3.body: 起草与核对用不同的模型、不同的提示词。两者设成同一个模型时，审稿台拒绝开工。
zh.front.rules.4.title: 永不自动发布
zh.front.rules.4.body: 产出的是草稿、出处和存疑标记，交给人审。发布这一步永远由人来做。
zh.front.tools.head: MCP 工具
zh.front.tools.aside: 下面这份清单直接读自 `agent.yaml`，与平台看到的契约是同一份。
zh.front.roles.head: 模型分工
zh.front.roles.aside: 按角色声明，具体模型名写在配置里，代码里从不写死。
zh.board.greeting: 今天想把哪篇论文写成稿子？
zh.board.greetingSub: 给我一个链接、DOI，或者把 PDF 拖进来。
zh.board.speaker: 白话
zh.board.composer: 粘贴论文链接、DOI，或把 PDF 拖进来
zh.dialog.livelinessNote: 只影响语气，不影响事实。
zh.dialog.ready: 准备好了，核对一下就可以开始。
zh.dialog.unrecognised: 没认出这是链接、DOI 还是 PDF。把论文网址贴进来试试。
zh.dialog.needPdf: 把 PDF 拖进下面的输入框，我再试一次。
zh.dialog.noClaims: 这一篇没能取到可引用的来源。
zh.board.orphansBody: 审校标出了这些问题，但稿子里已经找不到对应的句子了，请自行核对。
zh.flag.head: 存疑
zh.rewrite.head: 改写这段
zh.rewrite.ask: 想怎么改？例如：写短一点／别那么耸动／先说样本量
zh.rewrite.note: 事实仍以依据清单为准，改写不会新增事实。
zh.rewrite.applied: 已应用，完成审阅时会复核
zh.ledger.head: 依据清单
zh.ledger.note: 点一条，看正文里哪句引用了它
zh.ledger.hedgedBanner: {count} 条依据本身就不确定（{ids}）——引用它们的句子最值得改写。
zh.ledger.backgroundNote: 只用于行文，不是事实来源
zh.settings.rolesNote: 起草与审校必须使用不同的模型
zh.settings.verifyFailed: {count} 个角色没通过，把鼠标移到圆点上看原因
zh.settings.rule3: 起草与审校用了同一个模型，审校无法给自己打分。请换一个审校模型。
zh.settings.keysNote: 密钥只能在仓库根目录的 .env 里设置，界面不写入。
zh.settings.noKeys: 还没有任何模型密钥。在 .env 里加一行，然后重启服务。
zh.settings.modelsLive: 型号列表来自该密钥可用的模型
zh.settings.modelsFallback: 取不到型号列表，下面是备用清单
zh.settings.sourcesNote: 仅作行文背景，不是事实来源
zh.save.head: 保存
zh.save.clean: 复核通过，没有新的存疑。要存到本机吗？
zh.save.reopened: 复核又发现 {count} 处存疑，请继续处理。
zh.front.sell.head: 一篇论文，按平台分头起草，句句可查
zh.front.sell.1.title: 一稿多平台
zh.front.sell.1.body: 同一篇论文，自动产出新闻稿与小红书两种结构的草稿（公众号与小红书共用一张风格卡）；语言、受众、活泼度都是参数。
zh.front.sell.2.title: 句句有出处
zh.front.sell.2.body: 每条数字、因果、结论都对应论文里的一条依据，正文里带编号，点一下就能看到原文。
zh.front.sell.3.title: 夸大有预警
zh.front.sell.3.body: 逐句标出过度解读，标红交给你处理；依据本身不确定的句子另用琥珀色标出。
zh.front.agents.head: 四个 Agent，各司其职
zh.front.agents.lead: 论文 → 证据台账 → 分平台草稿 → 忠实核查。写作与核查用不同的模型。
zh.front.agents.caption: 台账同时交给写作员和审校员；背景素材只给写作员。审校员因此只能拿正文对照论文本身的依据——背景带来的夸大，一样会被标出来。
zh.front.agents.alt: 流程图：提取员建立证据台账，背景研究员提供背景素材，写作员起草，审校员对照台账核查并可退回重写。台账同时给写作员与审校员，背景素材只给写作员。
zh.front.agents.1.body: 抓取论文全文，抽成源卡片，逐条建立带来源与限定词的证据台账。台账是空的，就什么都不写。
zh.front.agents.2.body: 检索 arXiv、PubMed 等外部资料，只作行文背景，绝不当作事实——它写不进台账。
zh.front.agents.3.body: 按平台结构起草，受众与活泼度可调；每个事实句都标注它引用的台账编号。
zh.front.agents.4.body: 换一个更强的模型，只对着台账读稿子，标出夸大，最多退回重写两次。
zh.history.head: 历史
zh.history.empty: 还没有记录。起草一篇，它就会出现在这里。
zh.history.reopenNote: 重新打开的是原始草稿；上次的处理结果不会恢复。

en.app.name: ScicomAgent
en.lang.label: Language
en.front.hero.title: Turn a paper into something the public can actually read.
en.front.hero.lead: It reads the paper, extracts a claim ledger, drafts for each platform, then audits every sentence against that ledger with a different model. Anything that outruns its source is flagged for you.
en.front.demo.caption: What the ledger holds is what the draft may say
en.front.demo.claim: Tumour volume fell 23% on average in 12 mice
en.front.demo.writtenText: In 12 mice, tumour volume fell 23% on average (preliminary)
en.front.demo.why: Drops the species, the sample size and “preliminary” — the ledger cannot hold this sentence up.
en.front.rules.head: The rules it will not bend
en.front.rules.1.title: Written means sourced
en.front.rules.1.body: Every number, causal claim, magnitude, “first” or “proves” maps to a ledger entry, or it is not written.
en.front.rules.2.title: Qualifiers travel with the claim
en.front.rules.2.body: Species, sample size, “preliminary”, correlation-not-causation: carried into the prose, then checked.
en.front.rules.3.title: No grading your own work
en.front.rules.3.body: Drafting and checking use different models and different prompts. Set them the same and the board refuses to start.
en.front.rules.4.title: Never auto-published
en.front.rules.4.body: The output is a draft, its provenance and its flags — for a human. Publishing is never automated.
en.front.tools.head: MCP tools
en.front.tools.aside: Read straight from `agent.yaml`, so it is the same contract the platform sees.
en.front.roles.head: Model roles
en.front.roles.aside: Declared by role; concrete names live in config, never in code.
en.board.greetingSub: Give me a link, a DOI, or drop a PDF.
en.board.speaker: ScicomAgent
en.board.composer: Paste a paper link or DOI, or drop a PDF
en.dialog.askLiveliness: How lively should the tone be?
en.dialog.ready: Ready — check this over and I'll start.
en.dialog.unrecognised: That is not a link, a DOI, or a PDF — try pasting the paper's URL.
en.dialog.needPdf: Drop the PDF into the box below and I will try again.
en.dialog.noClaims: I could not get any citable source out of that one.
en.board.orphansBody: The reviewer raised these, but their sentence is no longer in the draft — check them by hand.
en.board.completeBlocked: every flag needs a decision first
en.flag.head: overstatement
en.rewrite.head: Rewrite this
en.rewrite.ask: How should this change? e.g. shorter / less dramatic / lead with the sample size
en.rewrite.note: The ledger still bounds the result — a rewrite never adds a fact.
en.rewrite.applied: Applied — it is re-checked when you complete the review
en.ledger.head: Claim ledger
en.ledger.note: Click one to find the sentences citing it
en.ledger.hedgedBanner: {count} claims are hedged ({ids}) — the sentences resting on them are the ones worth rewriting.
en.settings.rolesNote: Drafter and reviewer must be different models
en.settings.verifyFailed: {count} roles failed — hover a dot for why
en.settings.rule3: The drafter and the reviewer are the same model. A check cannot grade its own work — pick a different reviewer.
en.settings.keysNote: Keys are set in the repo's .env file. This interface never writes them.
en.settings.noKeys: No model API key found. Add one to .env, then restart the server.
en.settings.modelsFallback: Could not reach the provider — showing a fallback list
en.settings.sourcesNote: framing only, never a source of facts
en.save.head: Save
en.save.clean: The re-check came back clean. Save it to this machine?
en.save.reopened: The re-check found {count} more — keep going.
en.front.sell.head: One paper, drafted per platform, every sentence traceable
en.front.sell.1.title: One paper, every platform
en.front.sell.1.body: From a single paper it drafts for news and Xiaohongshu, each with its own structure (WeChat shares the Xiaohongshu style card). Language, audience and liveliness are parameters.
en.front.sell.2.title: Every sentence sourced
en.front.sell.2.body: Every number, causal claim and conclusion maps to one ledger entry, cited inline — click a citation to see the evidence behind it.
en.front.sell.3.title: Overstatement flagged
en.front.sell.3.body: Sentences that outrun their source are marked in red for you to accept or rewrite; sentences resting on hedged evidence are marked in amber.
en.front.agents.head: Four agents, one job each
en.front.agents.lead: Paper → claim ledger → per-platform draft → faithfulness check. Drafting and checking use different models.
en.front.agents.caption: The ledger goes to both the drafter and the reviewer; the background materials go only to the drafter. So the reviewer judges the prose against the paper's own evidence alone — an overstatement picked up from background gets flagged like any other.
en.front.agents.alt: Flow diagram: the extractor builds a claim ledger, the researcher supplies background, the drafter writes, and the reviewer checks the draft against the ledger and can send it back. The ledger reaches both drafter and reviewer; background reaches only the drafter.
en.front.agents.1.body: Pulls the full text, distils it into a source card, and builds a ledger of claims each carrying its evidence and its qualifier. An empty ledger means nothing gets written.
en.front.agents.2.body: Searches arXiv, PubMed and the rest for context. Framing only — it can never become a fact, and it never enters the ledger.
en.front.agents.3.body: Writes to each platform's structure, with audience and liveliness as dials, citing the ledger entry every factual sentence rests on.
en.front.agents.4.body: A stronger, different model reads the draft against the ledger alone, flags what overreaches, and sends it back to be rewritten at most twice.
en.history.head: History
en.history.empty: Nothing yet. Draft something and it will show up here.
en.history.reopenNote: Reopening gives you the original draft — earlier decisions are not restored.
